title: Verify Files Against Integrity Manifest
description: Compare current files with a previously created local integrity manifest.
code:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json

manifest = json.loads(Path('integrity-manifest.json').read_text())
for filename, expected in manifest.items():
    path = Path(filename)
    if not path.exists():
        print('MISSING:', filename)
        continue
    actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    print('OK' if actual == expected else 'CHANGED', filename)

title: Monitor a Log File for New Lines
description: Follow a local application log and display new lines as they arrive.
code:
import time
from pathlib import Path

log = Path('app.log')
with log.open() as f:
    f.seek(0, 2)
    while True:
        line = f.readline()
        if line:
            print(line, end='')
        else:
            time.sleep(1)

title: Count HTTP Status Codes in Access Log
description: Summarize response status codes from your own server log.
code:
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

counts = Counter()
for line in Path('access.log').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) > 8 and parts[8].isdigit():
        counts[parts[8]] += 1
print(counts)

title: Check Localhost HTTP Security Headers
description: Inspect common security headers on your own local web app.
code:
import urllib.request

url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=3) as r:
    for name in ['Content-Security-Policy', 'X-Content-Type-Options', 'X-Frame-Options', 'Referrer-Policy']:
        print(name, r.headers.get(name, 'MISSING'))

title: Check Localhost TLS Certificate Dates
description: Read certificate dates for your own local TLS service.
code:
import socket, ssl
from datetime import datetime, timezone

host = 'localhost'
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
with socket.create_connection((host, 443), timeout=3) as raw:
    with ctx.wrap_socket(raw, server_hostname=host) as tls:
        cert = tls.getpeercert()
        print('TLS:', tls.version())
        print('Expires:', cert.get('notAfter'))

title: Run a Small Authorized Lab Check List
description: Run basic checks against fixed localhost services only.
code:
import socket

checks = [('web-demo', '127.0.0.1', 8000), ('https-demo', '127.0.0.1', 443)]
for name, host, port in checks:
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.settimeout(1)
        result = s.connect_ex((host, port))
    print(name, 'open' if result == 0 else 'not open')
